Questions, answered

Good to
know.

What kind of projects do you take on?+

We work on software products, AI systems, web platforms, IoT solutions, automation systems and early-stage MVPs.

Can you work with an existing product?+

Yes. We can improve, redesign, integrate or extend an existing product.

How do we get started?+

Start with a short conversation describing the problem, product or idea you want to build.

Can you develop custom AI solutions?+

Yes. Solutions can include machine learning, computer vision, real-time recognition and edge AI depending on the problem.
